name: MVGS_CS_MV_ADMINISTRATIVE
title: MV-GenomSeq administrative concepts
description: Codes for administrative MV-GenomSeq facts that have no standard concept: the indication board (case conference deciding on inclusion), the Modellvorhaben genome sequencing it decides on, and the statement that no research consent is available.

concept.definition: Multidisciplinary case conference in the field of diagnostics deciding on the inclusion of the insured person in the Modellvorhaben Genomsequenzierung.
Genome sequencing within the Modellvorhaben Genomsequenzierung (§ 64e SGB V).
No research (Broad) consent can be submitted for the patient; the value states why.
